title: Bakery in Miami
assumptions: The filings are those of strict/miami-bakery-cafe.json (the same place; the kind of food business doesn't change them). What differs from a restaurant in Miami: DBPR's own page says FDACS licenses bakeries, so the agency is confirmed before filing.

items.name: Articles of Organization (Florida LLC)
items.agency: Florida Department of State, Division of Corporations
items.quote: One or more persons may act as authorized representatives to form a limited liability company by signing and delivering articles of organization to the department for filing.

items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.quote: You never have to pay a fee for an EIN.
items.feeQuote: You never have to pay a fee for an EIN.

items.name: Florida sales tax registration
items.quote: If they are, you must register to collect sales tax or pay use tax.

items.name: Certified food manager
items.agency: Florida DBPR, Division of Hotels and Restaurants
items.quote: Florida law requires food managers to complete training and pass a certification exam within 30 days of employment.

items.name: Food service plan review
items.agency: Florida DBPR, Division of Hotels and Restaurants
items.quote: Florida law and rule requires operators of public food service establishments to submit properly prepared facility plans and specifications to the division for review and approval

items.name: City of Miami Certificate of Use
items.quote: Most businesses need a CU before they can get a BTR.

items.name: Public food service establishment license
items.agency: Florida DBPR, Division of Hotels and Restaurants
items.quote: Florida law requires owners of new public food service or lodging establishments, and new owners of existing establishments, to obtain a license from the division before commencing operation.

items.name: City of Miami business tax receipt
items.quote: Every business needs to obtain a Business Tax Receipt to operate in the City (also known as an Occupational License).

items.name: Miami-Dade County local business tax receipt
items.quote: In addition, every business is also required to obtain a Miami-Dade County Local Business Tax Receipt (formerly known as an Occupational License).

items.name: Certificate of Occupancy or Completion after the build-out
items.quote: If you are in a new building OR a building that has undergone construction, then you will need to show either a Certificate of Occupancy (CO) or a Certificate of Completion (CC)

items.name: Workers' compensation insurance
items.agency: Florida Department of Financial Services, Division of Workers' Compensation
items.note: Added in the coverage audit of 2026-10-22: bought from an insurer once there is staff. Florida requires it of non-construction employers with four or more employees, so it is conditional here.
items.quote: Non-Construction Industry Employers with four (4) or more employees, including business owners who are corporate officers

facts.quote: FDACS licenses bakeries, grocery stores, and convenience stores.
